rows.coder_note: Step 3 (rule C): the authors' own analysis of UK Biobank individual-level data, defined by an application number (90143, also in p027) and by described measurements (IMT and almost 3000 proteins measured in UK Biobank, p002; own calculations using UK Biobank, p031). No passage attributes the outcome data to a published GWAS release, accession or citation; reference 40 (van der Harst 2018) is cited only for a gene's link to CHD and reference 47 (Sun 2023) is the pQTL source, not this row's dataset.
